x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change objection-advisory-committee (REQ-OAC-008). A decision whose type declares a term (fragment 132) records the moment the term counts from, and the server writes the date by which it has to be taken. `contests` names the decision it contests, so a term that counts from the end of the objection period can read that period from the contested decision's own legal remedy clause.

receivedAt.title: Received on
receivedAt.description: The day the request or the objection this decision answers was received.

contests.title: Contests
contests.description: The decision this decision answers an objection or an appeal against. Empty for a decision that contests nothing.

termEndsAt.title: Decide by
termEndsAt.description: The day by which this decision has to be taken: the term its decision type declares, counted from the moment the type names. Set by the server, never in a form; empty when the type declares no term or the moment is not known yet.
